name: Tripura
tagline: The Hidden Gem of the Northeast

topAttractions.name: Ujjayanta Palace
topAttractions.description: A stunning example of traditional Tripuri architecture, this palace was built in 1899 and features a unique blend of European and indigenous styles.

topAttractions.name: Neermahal Palace
topAttractions.description: A beautiful lakeside palace built in the 1930s, Neermahal is a must-visit for its stunning architecture and picturesque surroundings.

topAttractions.name: Sipahijala Wildlife Sanctuary
topAttractions.description: A haven for wildlife enthusiasts, this sanctuary is home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, including the endangered clouded leopard.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Tripura is from October to March, when the weather is cool and pleasant, making it ideal for sightseeing and outdoor activities.
culturalFact: Tripura is home to the Tripuri people, an indigenous community that has a rich tradition of handicrafts, particularly woodcarvings, which are GI-tagged and highly prized for their intricate designs.

hiddenGem.name: Bhuvaneswari Temple
hiddenGem.description: A beautiful temple dedicated to the goddess Bhuvaneswari, this ancient structure is a must-visit for its stunning architecture and historical significance.

relatedFestival: The Tripura International Film Festival, which is held annually in Agartala, showcasing a wide range of films from across the country and the world.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Ujjayanta Palace or the Neermahal Palace, you can tie in your Tripura visit with your existing stamps from these attractions!
